items.title: Rossano Sportiello interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, October 2, 2015 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: you know those chords stop being the Chopin thing but becomes the Hank Jones thing you know.

ctx.x: In other words, you’ve got to swing it.

Right. You’ve got to swing, and you know those chords stop being the Chopin thing but becomes the Hank Jones thing you know. And I love this transformation process. I had so many discussions with other piano players, colleagues, who in a way, they don’t feel the necessity of doing such a thing. And I understand this point of view. Because they might say you know a beautiful masterpiece of Chopin or Schumann or Beethoven, it doesn’t need anything else. It’s all there. Why you have to mess it up? And my answer is…
